name: Tab group settings (default)
description: The shared default settings interface for every tab group (chrome-settings@1): how the Settings dialog you reach by right-clicking one is laid out. Every tab row: page tabs, section switchers, settings tab bars, window tab bars. Every app gets its own copy (chrome-tab-group-<app>) that follows this one until edited; this default is what the dialog uses unless an app picks its copy. Look carries this one's own look (instance-look@1): a token picker per look key, a live preview, Reset to skin with one Undo; levelOf look.<key> sets each picker's level.
author: AmberX AXF
